text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey so... I was totally spamming
messages to my friends, but like...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
M-Man, those guys are seriously amazing...
Their conversation just never ends...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There's so much to talk about...
I'm glad you're doing well, but... *yaaaawn*.

Tosen Jordan seemed rather pleased,
yet looked sleepy the entire day.
